self.title: Cycle 42 · Synthesis of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory

detail.title: Synthesis of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory
detail.summary: This cycle reviewed evidence regarding the structural and functional requirements of chemical memory. Autocatalytic networks can be characterized by algebraic conditions on stoichiometric matrices to identify irreducible subnetworks. Experimental work in flow-controlled reaction systems demonstrates that these networks can produce programmable, history-dependent outputs distinct from simple hysteresis, offering a basis for neuromorphic-like chemical behavior. Research continues to define the boundary between persistent non-equilibrium states and functional memory.
